name: night-selfie-blonde-guy
image_purpose: Casual social profile visual and nighttime lifestyle post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical UGC nighttime selfie of an approved adult man, preserving the tousled blonde hair, white T-shirt, lounge chair, dry grass, and candid iPhone mood.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man with golden-blonde tousled curly hair, green eyes, defined jawline, natural skin texture, slight smile, and relaxed expression, wearing a plain white T-shirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Selfie from above with arm extended and slight tilt, subject reclining on an outdoor lounge chair. Include dry grass or hay field behind him, dark night sky, and a vertical 9:16 portrait crop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim warm ambient light from a nearby source balanced with cool night tones, soft shadows, starry or dark background, casual cinematic night mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic candid iPhone-style selfie, high-resolution natural portrait, realistic facial detail, subtle digital grain, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid smartphone selfie of an approved adult man with golden-blonde tousled curly hair, green eyes, defined jawline, natural skin texture, slight smile, and relaxed expression, wearing a plain white T-shirt. Reclining on an outdoor lounge chair at night, selfie from above with arm extended and slight tilt, dry grass or hay field behind him, dark night sky, dim warm nearby light balanced with cool night tones, soft shadows, realistic portrait detail, casual cinematic mood.
